title: secure_transport RH3 validation diverges from aligned survey (blackholes HBH+RH3 downward traffic)
description: Security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-xyix: rust/lichen-node/src/secure.rs secure_transport (secure.rs:1932-1950) rejects any RH3 not in first position, requires routing_len >= 24, and requires octets 6-7 plus the pad low nibble to be zero. The aligned survey (rpl_stack/util.rs) and the C router admit HBH-then-RH3, the 8-octet degenerate RH3, and ignored reserved bits (pinned by srh_admission.json vectors hop_by_hop_then_routing_in_transit, degenerate_zero_address_consumed, reserved_ignored_octets_admitted). receive.rs:244 runs secure_datagram_from_received before the survey on every non-RPL datagram, so RPL relays drop legitimately shaped downward traffic where C forwards it (availability divergence, and a survey-vs-gate contradiction within one binary). Fix: align secure_transport's RH3 parsing/validation with survey_routing_headers policy.
